# Making the stream to join with fails: the chat is still joining, and when the client starts
# again it joins the group rather than founding one of its own.

fail-next bob Create
join bob g
run
state bob g
----
not joined, minting

show bob g
----
— new stream failed: injected

restart bob
run
state bob g
----
not joined, awaiting a reply

create alice g
run
invite alice g bob
run
members bob g
----
alice

members alice g
----
bob
